releaseNotes:
• RGB Mechanical Keyboard Lighting FX: Dynamic multi-color wave and ripple shockwaves on keypresses
• Dynamic App Chameleon Theme: Auto-adapts keyboard colors to foreground apps (WhatsApp, YouTube, Telegram, Facebook, Spotify, X)
• Font Customizer: Choose between Modern Medium, Tech Condensed, Casual Rounded, Cyber Mono, and Classic Serif fonts
• Shift & CapsLock Bug Fix: Accurate lowercase vs uppercase letter visibility and double-tap CapsLock
• Smart Contextual Emojis & Clean 4-Word Chips: Instant emoji popups on words ('love', 'tea', 'hina') and spacious prediction pills
• 1-Hour Auto-Expire Clipboard: Automatically cleans up unpinned clips after 1 hour with full manual deletion
